methods_quotes.q: Among persons with COVID-19 after primary vaccination, a logistic regression model was specified to estimate the odds for severe versus nonsevere outcomes.
The risk for COVID-19 severe outcomes and deaths per 10,000 persons were calculated among persons who completed primary vaccination.
Receipt of anti–SARS-CoV-2 monoclonal antibodies was not entered in the model, because no severe outcomes were identified in this subgroup.
All analyses were performed using SAS statistical software (version 9.4; SAS Institute); p-values <0.05 were considered statistically significant.
